artifacts.delta_brief: Between 2021 and 2022, NVDA continues to emphasize manufacturing and security as core risk exposure (2021 para 96; 2022 para 179). The earlier filing is relatively more anchored in manufacturing, while the later filing adds clearer weight to security (2021 para 38; 2022 para 41). Across both years, management frames these items as operational and financial execution pressures rather than isolated one-off events (2021 para 96; 2022 para 41). This comparison should be read as directional because the lens is a focuspack subset and not the full Item 1A text (2021 para 38; 2022 para 179). Overall, the narrative indicates continuity with selective shifts in emphasis instead of a full thematic reset (2021 para 96; 2022 para 179).
